sloka: कौसल्यायाम् महा तेजा यथा मातरि वर्तते ।तथा यो वर्तते अस्मासु महात्मा क्व नु गच्चति ॥२-४१-४॥
transliteration: kausalyāyām mahā tejā yathā mātari vartate ।tathā yo vartate asmāsu mahātmā kva nu gaccati ॥2-41-4॥

translations.english: Where is he, that effulgent, magnanimous one who treated us (with the same respect) as he treated his mother Kausalya, going now?
